/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   جمعية طويق للخدمات الإنسانية — ثيم متجر زد الكامل
   الهوية البصرية: أخضر طويق + ذهبي + كريمي دافئ
   الخطوط: Cairo (عناوين) + Tajawal (نصوص)
   النسخة: 1.0 — 2026-05-04
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── 1. خطوط جوجل العربية ──────────────────────────────────── */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Tajawal:wght@300;400;500;700;800&display=swap');

/* ── 2. متغيرات الألوان الرسمية لجمعية طويق ───────────────── */
:root {
  /* الأخضر الرئيسي */
  --twq-green:         hsl(152, 42%, 28%);
  --twq-green-dark:    hsl(152, 42%, 20%);
  --twq-green-mid:     hsl(152, 48%, 36%);
  --twq-green-light:   hsl(152, 40%, 94%);
  --twq-green-xlight:  hsl(152, 35%, 97%);

  /* الذهبي البرونزي */
  --twq-gold:          hsl(28, 44%, 59%);
  --twq-gold-dark:     hsl(26, 52%, 42%);
  --twq-gold-light:    hsl(35, 60%, 85%);

  /* الكحلي الثانوي */
  --twq-navy:          hsl(211, 40%, 28%);
  --twq-navy-dark:     hsl(211, 40%, 18%);

  /* الخلفيات */
  --twq-cream:         hsl(35, 28%, 97%);
  --twq-cream-2:       hsl(35, 18%, 93%);
  --twq-white:         #ffffff;

  /* النصوص */
  --twq-text:          hsl(210, 22%, 14%);
  --twq-text-muted:    hsl(215, 15%, 48%);
  --twq-text-light:    hsl(215, 12%, 65%);

  /* الحدود */
  --twq-border:        hsl(35, 15%, 86%);
  --twq-border-focus:  hsl(152, 42%, 55%);

  /* الزوايا والظلال */
  --twq-radius-sm:     8px;
  --twq-radius:        12px;
  --twq-radius-lg:     18px;
  --twq-radius-xl:     24px;
  --twq-radius-full:   9999px;

  --twq-shadow-sm:     0 1px 4px hsla(152, 42%, 28%, 0.08);
  --twq-shadow:        0 4px 20px hsla(152, 42%, 28%, 0.14);
  --twq-shadow-lg:     0 8px 40px hsla(152, 42%, 28%, 0.2);
  --twq-shadow-gold:   0 4px 20px hsla(28, 44%, 59%, 0.35);

  /* اللوغو مدمج في الكود */
  --twq-logo: url("data:image/png;base64,");
}

/* ── 3. الأساس العام ────────────────────────────────────────── */
*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  direction: rtl;
  font-size: 16px;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif !important;
  background-color: var(--twq-cream) !important;
  color: var(--twq-text) !important;
  line-height: 1.7;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--twq-text) !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

p, span, li, td, th, div {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
}

a {
  color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: color 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
}

a:hover {
  color: var(--twq-green-dark) !important;
  opacity: 0.85;
}

img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

::selection {
  background: hsla(152, 42%, 28%, 0.15);
  color: var(--twq-text);
}

/* ── 4. الهيدر والنافيجيشن ─────────────────────────────────── */
header,
.header,
.site-header,
nav,
.navbar,
.nav-bar,
.navigation,
[class*="site-header"],
[class*="main-header"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  background-color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--twq-gold) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 20px hsla(152, 42%, 15%, 0.3) !important;
}

/* لينكات الهيدر */
header a,
.header a,
.navbar a,
.nav-bar a,
.navigation a,
nav a,
header .nav-link,
.navbar .nav-link {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92) !important;
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
  padding: 6px 12px;
}

header a:hover,
.navbar a:hover,
nav a:hover {
  color: hsl(35, 80%, 82%) !important;
}

/* الشريط العلوي */
.top-bar,
.topbar,
.header-top,
.announcement-bar,
[class*="top-bar"],
[class*="topbar"],
[class*="header-top"] {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--twq-green-dark), hsl(152, 35%, 25%)) !important;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88) !important;
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid hsla(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
}

/* الشريط السفلي للهيدر */
.header-bottom,
.nav-bottom,
.main-nav,
[class*="header-bottom"] {
  background-color: var(--twq-cream) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--twq-border) !important;
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
}

.header-bottom a,
.main-nav a {
  color: var(--twq-text) !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
}

/* اللوغو */
.logo,
.site-logo,
.brand-logo,
.store-logo,
[class*="logo"],
[class*="brand"] img {
  max-height: 56px !important;
  width: auto !important;
}

/* استبدال اللوغو بلوغو طويق إذا كان فارغاً */
.logo:empty::before,
.site-logo:empty::before {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  width: 120px;
  height: 56px;
  background: var(--twq-logo) center/contain no-repeat;
}

/* ── 5. قائمة الدروب داون ──────────────────────────────────── */
.dropdown-menu,
.submenu,
[class*="dropdown-menu"],
[class*="submenu"] {
  background-color: var(--twq-white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--twq-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--twq-shadow-lg) !important;
  padding: 8px 0 !important;
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.dropdown-menu a,
.submenu a,
[class*="dropdown-menu"] a {
  color: var(--twq-text) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  padding: 10px 18px !important;
  display: block;
  transition: background 0.15s ease !important;
}

.dropdown-menu a:hover,
.submenu a:hover {
  background-color: var(--twq-green-light) !important;
  color: var(--twq-green-dark) !important;
}

/* ── 6. الأزرار ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* الزر الرئيسي الأخضر */
.btn-primary,
.button-primary,
.btn[class*="primary"],
[class*="btn-primary"],
[class*="button-primary"],
.add-to-cart,
.buy-now,
[class*="add-to-cart"],
[class*="buy-now"],
[class*="checkout-btn"],
[class*="place-order"],
button[type="submit"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--twq-green), var(--twq-green-mid)) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius) !important;
  padding: 13px 28px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px hsla(152, 42%, 28%, 0.35) !important;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.btn-primary:hover,
.button-primary:hover,
.add-to-cart:hover,
.buy-now:hover,
[class*="add-to-cart"]:hover,
[class*="checkout-btn"]:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--twq-green-dark), var(--twq-green)) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 28px hsla(152, 42%, 28%, 0.5) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}

/* زر الـ CTA الذهبي */
.btn-secondary,
.button-secondary,
.btn-cta,
.btn-gold,
[class*="btn-secondary"],
[class*="button-secondary"],
[class*="btn-cta"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--twq-gold), var(--twq-gold-dark)) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius) !important;
  padding: 13px 28px !important;
  box-shadow: var(--twq-shadow-gold) !important;
  transition: all 0.25s ease !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
}

.btn-secondary:hover,
[class*="btn-secondary"]:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--twq-gold-dark), hsl(26, 52%, 35%)) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}

/* أزرار Outline */
.btn-outline,
.button-outline,
[class*="btn-outline"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--twq-green) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius) !important;
  padding: 11px 26px !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
}

.btn-outline:hover,
[class*="btn-outline"]:hover {
  background: var(--twq-green) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: var(--twq-shadow) !important;
}

/* زر الرابط */
.btn-link,
[class*="btn-link"] {
  color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  text-decoration: underline !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
}

/* أزرار التصفية والفلترة */
.filter-btn,
[class*="filter-btn"],
[class*="filter-tab"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-full) !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}

.filter-btn.active,
[class*="filter-btn"].active,
[class*="filter-tab"].active {
  background-color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
}

/* ── 7. بطاقات المنتجات ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.product-card,
.product-item,
.item-card,
[class*="product-card"],
[class*="product-item"],
.card {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  background-color: var(--twq-white) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-lg) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--twq-border) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--twq-shadow-sm) !important;
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  position: relative;
}

.product-card:hover,
.product-item:hover,
[class*="product-card"]:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--twq-shadow-lg) !important;
  transform: translateY(-6px) !important;
  border-color: hsl(152, 42%, 70%) !important;
}

/* صورة المنتج */
.product-image,
.product-thumbnail,
[class*="product-image"],
[class*="product-img"],
[class*="product-thumb"] {
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius) var(--twq-radius) 0 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  aspect-ratio: 1/1;
  object-fit: cover;
}

/* اسم المنتج */
.product-name,
.product-title,
.item-name,
[class*="product-name"],
[class*="product-title"],
[class*="item-name"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--twq-text) !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  line-height: 1.5 !important;
}

/* السعر */
.product-price,
.price,
.item-price,
[class*="product-price"],
[class*="item-price"],
[class*="price"]:not([class*="shipping"]):not([class*="deliver"]) {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  font-size: 18px !important;
  direction: ltr;
}

/* السعر المشطوب */
.old-price,
.original-price,
.compare-price,
[class*="old-price"],
[class*="original-price"],
[class*="compare-price"],
del, s {
  color: var(--twq-text-light) !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 400 !important;
  text-decoration: line-through !important;
}

/* بادج الخصم */
.discount-badge,
.sale-badge,
.badge,
[class*="discount-badge"],
[class*="sale-badge"],
[class*="-badge"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--twq-gold), var(--twq-gold-dark)) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-sm) !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  padding: 3px 8px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

/* بادج "جديد" */
.new-badge,
[class*="new-badge"],
[class*="badge-new"] {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--twq-green), var(--twq-green-mid)) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
}

/* بادج "نفذت الكمية" */
.out-of-stock,
[class*="out-of-stock"],
[class*="sold-out"] {
  background-color: hsl(215, 15%, 48%) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
}

/* ── 8. صفحة المنتج التفصيلية ────────────────────────────── */
.product-single,
.product-details,
.product-page,
[class*="product-single"],
[class*="product-detail"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  background-color: var(--twq-white) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-lg) !important;
  padding: 28px !important;
  box-shadow: var(--twq-shadow-sm) !important;
}

/* عنوان المنتج الرئيسي */
.product-single h1,
.product-title h1,
[class*="product-title"] h1 {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 26px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: var(--twq-text) !important;
}

/* وصف المنتج */
.product-description,
.description,
[class*="product-description"],
[class*="description"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  line-height: 1.9 !important;
  color: var(--twq-text-muted) !important;
}

/* الكمية */
.quantity,
.quantity-selector,
.qty,
[class*="quantity"],
[class*="qty"] {
  border: 2px solid var(--twq-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius) !important;
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
}

.quantity button,
.qty-btn,
[class*="quantity"] button {
  background-color: var(--twq-green-light) !important;
  color: var(--twq-green-dark) !important;
  border: none !important;
  font-size: 18px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  transition: background 0.2s ease !important;
}

.quantity button:hover,
[class*="quantity"] button:hover {
  background-color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
}

/* ── 9. صفحة الفئات ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.category-card,
.category-item,
.collection-card,
[class*="category-card"],
[class*="category-item"],
[class*="collection-card"] {
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-lg) !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
  box-shadow: var(--twq-shadow-sm) !important;
}

.category-card:hover,
[class*="category-card"]:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--twq-shadow-lg) !important;
}

.category-name,
[class*="category-name"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

/* ── 10. الفلاتر والتصفية ──────────────────────────────────── */
.filter-sidebar,
.filters,
.sidebar,
[class*="filter-sidebar"],
[class*="sidebar"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  background-color: var(--twq-white) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-lg) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--twq-border) !important;
  padding: 20px !important;
  box-shadow: var(--twq-shadow-sm) !important;
}

.filter-title,
[class*="filter-title"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--twq-text) !important;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--twq-green-light) !important;
  padding-bottom: 10px !important;
  margin-bottom: 14px !important;
}

/* ── 11. الـ Inputs والـ Forms ──────────────────────────────── */
input[type="text"],
input[type="email"],
input[type="password"],
input[type="tel"],
input[type="number"],
input[type="search"],
select,
textarea,
.form-control,
.input,
[class*="form-control"],
[class*="-input"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--twq-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius) !important;
  padding: 11px 16px !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  color: var(--twq-text) !important;
  background-color: var(--twq-white) !important;
  width: 100%;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease !important;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

input:focus,
select:focus,
textarea:focus,
.form-control:focus {
  outline: none !important;
  border-color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsla(152, 42%, 28%, 0.12) !important;
}

label,
.form-label,
.input-label,
[class*="form-label"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  color: var(--twq-text) !important;
  margin-bottom: 6px !important;
  display: block;
}

/* Placeholder */
::placeholder {
  color: var(--twq-text-light) !important;
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
}

/* شريط البحث */
.search-bar,
.search-form,
[class*="search-bar"],
[class*="search-form"] {
  position: relative;
}

.search-bar input,
.search-form input,
[class*="search-bar"] input {
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-full) !important;
  padding: 12px 22px !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--twq-border) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
}

.search-bar input:focus {
  border-color: var(--twq-green) !important;
}

.search-submit,
.search-btn,
[class*="search-submit"],
[class*="search-btn"] {
  background-color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-full) !important;
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  padding: 10px 20px !important;
}

/* ── 12. سلة التسوق ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.cart,
.cart-page,
.shopping-cart,
[class*="cart-page"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
}

.cart-item,
[class*="cart-item"],
[class*="cart-row"] {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--twq-border) !important;
  padding: 18px 0 !important;
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
}

.cart-item-name,
[class*="cart-item-name"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--twq-text) !important;
}

.cart-total,
.order-total,
.grand-total,
[class*="cart-total"],
[class*="order-total"],
[class*="grand-total"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  font-size: 22px !important;
  color: var(--twq-green) !important;
}

.cart-summary,
.order-summary,
[class*="cart-summary"],
[class*="order-summary"] {
  background-color: var(--twq-green-xlight) !important;
  border: 1px solid hsl(152, 40%, 85%) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-lg) !important;
  padding: 24px !important;
}

/* أيقونة السلة */
.cart-icon,
.cart-link,
[class*="cart-icon"],
[class*="cart-link"] {
  color: #ffffff !important;
  position: relative;
}

.cart-count,
[class*="cart-count"],
[class*="cart-badge"] {
  background-color: var(--twq-gold) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-full) !important;
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  min-width: 20px !important;
  height: 20px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
}

/* ── 13. صفحة الشراء والدفع ────────────────────────────────── */
.checkout,
.checkout-page,
[class*="checkout-page"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  background-color: var(--twq-cream) !important;
}

.checkout-section,
[class*="checkout-section"] {
  background-color: var(--twq-white) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-lg) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--twq-border) !important;
  padding: 24px !important;
  margin-bottom: 18px !important;
  box-shadow: var(--twq-shadow-sm) !important;
}

.checkout-section h2,
.checkout-section h3,
[class*="checkout-section"] h2 {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--twq-green-dark) !important;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--twq-green-light) !important;
  padding-bottom: 12px !important;
  margin-bottom: 18px !important;
}

/* ── 14. الـ Footer ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
footer,
.footer,
.site-footer,
[class*="site-footer"],
[class*="main-footer"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, hsl(152, 38%, 13%), hsl(152, 42%, 18%)) !important;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82) !important;
  border-top: 4px solid var(--twq-gold) !important;
}

footer h3,
footer h4,
footer h5,
.footer h3,
.footer h4,
[class*="footer"] h3,
[class*="footer"] h4 {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

footer h3::after,
.footer h3::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 36px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--twq-gold);
  border-radius: 2px;
}

footer a,
.footer a,
[class*="footer"] a {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72) !important;
  transition: color 0.2s ease !important;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-size: 14px;
}

footer a:hover,
.footer a:hover {
  color: hsl(35, 70%, 78%) !important;
}

.footer-bottom,
.copyright,
[class*="footer-bottom"],
[class*="copyright"] {
  background-color: hsla(0, 0%, 0%, 0.25) !important;
  border-top: 1px solid hsla(255, 255, 255, 0.1) !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) !important;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 14px 0 !important;
}

/* ── 15. الـ Pagination ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.pagination,
[class*="pagination"] {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.pagination a,
.pagination button,
.page-link,
[class*="pagination"] a,
[class*="pagination"] button {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--twq-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius) !important;
  padding: 8px 14px !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
  background-color: var(--twq-white) !important;
}

.pagination a:hover,
.pagination button:hover,
[class*="pagination"] a:hover {
  background-color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-color: var(--twq-green) !important;
}

.pagination .active,
.pagination .current,
[class*="pagination"] .active {
  background-color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-color: var(--twq-green) !important;
}

/* ── 16. الرسائل والتنبيهات ─────────────────────────────────── */
.alert,
.notification,
.message,
[class*="alert"],
[class*="notification"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius) !important;
  padding: 14px 18px !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
}

.alert-success,
[class*="alert-success"],
[class*="success-alert"],
[class*="success-message"] {
  background-color: var(--twq-green-light) !important;
  color: var(--twq-green-dark) !important;
  border: 1px solid hsl(152, 42%, 72%) !important;
}

.alert-error,
.alert-danger,
[class*="alert-error"],
[class*="alert-danger"],
[class*="error-message"] {
  background-color: hsl(0, 80%, 97%) !important;
  color: hsl(0, 70%, 45%) !important;
  border: 1px solid hsl(0, 70%, 82%) !important;
}

.alert-warning,
[class*="alert-warning"] {
  background-color: hsl(35, 90%, 96%) !important;
  color: var(--twq-gold-dark) !important;
  border: 1px solid hsl(35, 60%, 78%) !important;
}

.alert-info,
[class*="alert-info"] {
  background-color: hsl(211, 60%, 96%) !important;
  color: var(--twq-navy) !important;
  border: 1px solid hsl(211, 40%, 78%) !important;
}

/* ── 17. التقييمات والنجوم ──────────────────────────────────── */
.stars,
.rating,
.star,
[class*="stars"],
[class*="rating"],
[class*="star-rating"] {
  color: var(--twq-gold) !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
}

.review-count,
[class*="review-count"] {
  color: var(--twq-text-muted) !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
}

/* ── 18. عناوين الأقسام ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.section-title,
.section-heading,
.section-header,
[class*="section-title"],
[class*="section-heading"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: var(--twq-text) !important;
  font-size: 24px !important;
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.section-title::after,
[class*="section-title"]::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 52px;
  height: 4px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--twq-green), var(--twq-gold));
  border-radius: 4px;
}

/* الشارة العلوية للقسم */
.section-label,
[class*="section-label"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  color: var(--twq-gold-dark) !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ── 19. الـ Breadcrumb ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.breadcrumb,
[class*="breadcrumb"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  color: var(--twq-text-muted) !important;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.breadcrumb a,
[class*="breadcrumb"] a {
  color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
}

.breadcrumb-separator,
.breadcrumb span,
[class*="breadcrumb"] span:not(a span) {
  color: var(--twq-text-light) !important;
}

/* ── 20. Tabs والقوائم ──────────────────────────────────────── */
.tabs,
.tab-nav,
[class*="tabs"],
[class*="tab-nav"] {
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--twq-border) !important;
}

.tab,
.tab-item,
[class*="tab-item"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  color: var(--twq-text-muted) !important;
  padding: 10px 18px !important;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
  margin-bottom: -2px;
}

.tab.active,
.tab-item.active,
[class*="tab-item"].active {
  color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  border-bottom-color: var(--twq-green) !important;
}

/* ── 21. الـ Modals والـ Popups ─────────────────────────────── */
.modal,
.popup,
.dialog,
[class*="modal"],
[class*="popup"],
[class*="dialog"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
}

.modal-content,
.popup-content,
[class*="modal-content"],
[class*="popup-content"] {
  background-color: var(--twq-white) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-xl) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px hsla(152, 42%, 10%, 0.3) !important;
  border: none !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.modal-header,
[class*="modal-header"] {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--twq-green), var(--twq-green-mid)) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  padding: 18px 24px !important;
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

.modal-close,
.popup-close,
[class*="modal-close"],
[class*="popup-close"] {
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8) !important;
  font-size: 22px !important;
}

/* ── 22. صفحة الحساب والتسجيل ──────────────────────────────── */
.account-page,
.auth-page,
.login-page,
[class*="account-page"],
[class*="login-page"],
[class*="register-page"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
}

.auth-card,
.login-card,
.account-card,
[class*="auth-card"],
[class*="login-card"] {
  background-color: var(--twq-white) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-xl) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--twq-border) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--twq-shadow-lg) !important;
  padding: 32px !important;
}

.auth-title,
[class*="auth-title"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: var(--twq-green-dark) !important;
  font-size: 24px !important;
}

/* ── 23. البانر الرئيسي والسلايدر ──────────────────────────── */
.hero,
.banner,
.hero-section,
.main-banner,
.slider,
.carousel,
[class*="hero"],
[class*="main-banner"],
[class*="slider"],
[class*="carousel"] {
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-xl) !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}

.hero-title,
.banner-title,
[class*="hero-title"],
[class*="banner-title"] {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 12px hsla(0, 0%, 0%, 0.3);
}

.hero-subtitle,
.banner-subtitle,
[class*="hero-subtitle"],
[class*="banner-subtitle"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88) !important;
}

/* السلايدر نقاط التنقل */
.slider-dots,
.carousel-dots,
[class*="slider-dot"],
[class*="carousel-dot"] {
  background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-full) !important;
  transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
}

.slider-dots.active,
[class*="slider-dot"].active {
  background-color: var(--twq-gold) !important;
  width: 24px !important;
}

/* ── 24. شريط التقدم ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.progress,
.progress-bar,
[class*="progress-bar"] {
  background-color: var(--twq-green-light) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-full) !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.progress-fill,
[class*="progress-fill"],
[class*="progress-value"] {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--twq-green), var(--twq-green-mid)) !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-full) !important;
}

/* ── 25. Tooltips ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.tooltip,
[class*="tooltip"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  background-color: var(--twq-navy-dark) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-sm) !important;
  padding: 6px 10px !important;
}

/* ── 26. زر الواتساب ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.whatsapp-btn,
.whatsapp-float,
[class*="whatsapp"],
[href*="whatsapp"],
[href*="wa.me"] {
  background-color: #25D366 !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-radius: var(--twq-radius-full) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px hsla(142, 70%, 40%, 0.4) !important;
  transition: all 0.25s ease !important;
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 24px;
  left: 24px;
  z-index: 9999;
}

/* ── 27. شريط التحميل ───────────────────────────────────────── */
.loading,
.spinner,
[class*="loading"],
[class*="spinner"] {
  color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  border-color: var(--twq-green) !important;
}

/* ── 28. جدول المقارنة ──────────────────────────────────────── */
table,
.table,
[class*="table"] {
  font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif !important;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  width: 100%;
}

table th,
.table th {
  font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  background-color: var(--twq-green) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  padding: 12px 16px !important;
  text-align: right;
}

table td,
.table td {
  padding: 11px 16px !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--twq-border) !important;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

table tr:hover td {
  background-color: var(--twq-green-xlight) !important;
}

/* ── 29. الـ Scrollbar ──────────────────────────────────────── */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: var(--twq-cream-2);
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: hsl(152, 35%, 55%);
  border-radius: 10px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: var(--twq-green);
}

/* ── 30. تأثيرات وأنيميشن ──────────────────────────────────── */
@keyframes twq-pulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
  50% { transform: scale(1.04); }
}

@keyframes twq-shimmer {
  0% { background-position: 200% center; }
  100% { background-position: -200% center; }
}

@keyframes twq-fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.product-card,
[class*="product-card"] {
  animation: twq-fadeIn 0.4s ease both;
}

/* ── 31. الجوال والأجهزة الصغيرة ──────────────────────────── */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  body {
    font-size: 15px !important;
  }

  h1 { font-size: 22px !important; line-height: 1.4 !important; }
  h2 { font-size: 19px !important; }
  h3 { font-size: 16px !important; }

  .product-card,
  [class*="product-card"] {
    border-radius: 12px !important;
  }

  .btn-primary,
  .button-primary,
  .add-to-cart,
  .buy-now,
  button[type="submit"] {
    width: 100% !important;
    padding: 15px !important;
    font-size: 16px !important;
    border-radius: 12px !important;
  }

  .section-title,
  [class*="section-title"] {
    font-size: 20px !important;
  }

  header,
  .header,
  .navbar {
    padding: 12px 16px !important;
  }

  .logo,
  [class*="logo"] {
    max-height: 44px !important;
  }

  footer,
  .footer {
    text-align: center;
  }

  footer h3::after,
  .footer h3::after {
    right: 50% !important;
    transform: translateX(50%) !important;
  }

  .search-bar input {
    font-size: 16px !important; /* يمنع zoom في iOS */
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .product-card,
  [class*="product-card"] {
    border-radius: 10px !important;
  }
}

/* ── 32. الطباعة ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@media print {
  header, footer, .navbar { display: none !important; }
  body { background: white !important; color: black !important; }
  .btn-primary, .add-to-cart { display: none !important; }
}
